name: @capnagent-examples/mcp-shell-agent
description: Third real-world consumer of @capnagent/mcp: a capability-bounded shell agent. Closes the high-risk-tool-surface trifecta (filesystem, HTTP, shell). The capability allowlists a specific argv shape; everything else — including subtle variants like `git push` or `rm -rf /` — is denied before the shell ever sees the call.
